_doc: build_versions.py knobs. endcards: per-version backdrop still for frames 1890-2099 (null/missing -> the end card as it is in the picture). endcard_look: dim = overall brightness of the still, band = extra darkening behind boat/title/names (0..1), zoom = push-in over 7 s. inserts: list of {from, to, clip, offset, crop, box, enabled} per version or 'all' - replace picture frames from..to (inclusive) with clip (seconds offset; crop w:h:x:y applied to the clip first; box x:y:w:h target, default the 2.39 picture area 0:138:1920:804). Clip frames are retimed 24->30 fps (speed 0.8 = each source frame shown once), cropped to the 1920x804 band at y (default 138), graded with 'grade' (ffmpeg filter, default eq=contrast=0.94:saturation=0.92).
